name: Filikod – Media Cleanup & ALT Text
author: Filikod

sections.description:
Filikod is a lightweight WordPress plugin designed to help you keep your media library clean, accessible and SEO-ready without complexity or AI guesswork.

Most websites technically have ALT text, but in reality:
– many ALT attributes are generic (“logo”, “image”),

  • duplicated across multiple images,

  • or too short to be useful for accessibility and SEO.

  • many ALT attributes are generic (“logo”, “image”),

Filikod goes further than simple automation.

It audits your existing images, highlights real ALT issues, and gives you a clear ALT Quality Score (0–100%) so you instantly know where you stand.

Unlike most image plugins, Filikod does not try to “guess” image content with AI.

It relies on deterministic rules, accessibility best practices, and transparent scoring.

You stay in control. Filikod shows you what needs attention and lets you fix it.

Learn more at https://filikod.com/

Features

ALT Audit & Accessibility Health

  • Global ALT Quality Score (0–100%) based on:

    • missing ALT text

    • generic ALT text (multi-language detection)

    • ALT text that is too short

    • duplicated ALT text

    • valid ALT text

  • Clear visual indicators with a donut gauge

  • One-click access to detailed ALT audit lists

  • Inline ALT editing directly from the audit table

ALT Text Automation

  • Automatically generate ALT text from filenames

  • Applies only to images without existing ALT

  • Clean special characters for readability and SEO

  • Optional removal of redundant title attributes

Image Resizing (Upload & Bulk)

  • Resize images on upload based on a maximum width

  • Maintain original aspect ratio automatically

  • Replace oversized originals to save disk space (optional)

  • Bulk resize existing images from the dashboard

Secure SVG & File Handling

  • Secure SVG upload with XML sanitization

  • Block unsafe tags like <script>, <iframe>, etc.

  • Toggle support for extended file types:

    SVGZ, PSD, AI, EPS, ICO, ZIP, RAR, 7Z, WEBM

  • Visual warnings for potentially unsafe formats

Clean & Modern Admin Dashboard

  • Alt Text Health: ALT Quality Score with issue breakdown

  • Media Size Savings: resizing impact percentage and saved size

  • Library Overview: total images, total media size, average image weight

  • Clear, readable and responsive interface

  • Works in single-site and multisite environments

What Filikod Is NOT

Filikod is not:

  • an AI-generated ALT engine

  • an image compression or CDN plugin

  • a WebP / AVIF converter (planned for premium)

It focuses on audit, hygiene and automation not black-box optimization.

Compatibility

  • WordPress 5.8+

  • PHP 7.4+

  • Compatible with all themes and page builders (Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, WPBakery…)

  • Works with GD and Imagick

  • Multisite compatible
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Filikod from the WordPress plugin directory.

  2. Go to Filikod → Settings.

  3. Enable ALT tools, image resizing, SVG security or file types as needed.

New uploads are processed automatically.

Use bulk tools to audit and clean existing images.
sections.faq:
Does Filikod compress images?

No. Filikod resizes images based on the maximum width you define, but it does not perform compression or format conversion.

Does Filikod overwrite original images?

If resizing is enabled, oversized originals are replaced to save storage space.

Can I use Filikod with Elementor, Divi or WooCommerce?

Yes. Filikod works with all major builders and plugins.

Can I audit existing images?

Yes. Filikod analyzes your entire media library and highlights ALT issues with clear scoring.

Does Filikod support WebP or AVIF?

Not in the free version. These features are planned for a future premium release.

Where can I get help?

Documentation and support: https://filikod.com/
